gloss: to divide up; to distribute; to allocate

definitions.gloss: to divide up; to distribute; to allocate
definitions.explanation: to split something into portions and assign them to different places, people, or categories

examples.japanese: {仕事|しごと}をチームに{振|ふ}り{分|わ}けた。
examples.english: I distributed the work among the team.

examples.japanese: {予算|よさん}を{各|かく}{部署|ぶしょ}に{振|ふ}り{分|わ}ける。
examples.english: We allocate the budget to each department.

examples.japanese: {荷物|にもつ}を{左右|さゆう}の{袋|ふくろ}に{振|ふ}り{分|わ}けて{持|も}った。
examples.english: I divided the luggage between bags on each side.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY:
Transitive ({他動詞|たどうし})

USAGE:
- 〜を{振|ふ}り{分|わ}ける (to divide/allocate ~)
- AをBに{振|ふ}り{分|わ}ける (to allocate A to B)

COMMON CONTEXTS:
- {仕事|しごと}を{振|ふ}り{分|わ}ける (distribute work)
- {予算|よさん}を{振|ふ}り{分|わ}ける (allocate budget)
- {役割|やくわり}を{振|ふ}り{分|わ}ける (assign roles)

RELATED:
- {割|わ}り{振|ふ}る (to allot, assign)
- {配分|はいぶん}する (to distribute, allocate)
- {分担|ぶんたん}する (to share responsibility)
